title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released **Claude Fable 5** — the most capable model it has ever made publicly available — alongside **Claude Mythos 5**, a restricted variant for government-adjacent cybersecurity work. Fable 5 is the first "Mythos-class" model accessible to general users and represents a significant leap over the Claude 4.x generation.

---

## What Is the Mythos Class?

The Mythos class is Anthropic's internal designation for models trained specifically to reason about complex technical domains including software vulnerabilities, scientific research, and long-horizon autonomous task execution. The original Claude Mythos (April 2026) was never released publicly due to safety and misuse concerns. Fable 5 is a version of this architecture made available with conservative safeguards applied.

---

## Benchmark Performance

Fable 5 achieves state-of-the-art results across nearly all tested benchmarks:

- **Software engineering:** Highest-ever scores on SWE-bench Verified
- **Knowledge work:** Top results on MMLU-Pro and GPQA
- **Vision:** State-of-the-art on MathVista and DocVQA
- **Autonomous task execution:** Long-horizon agentic tasks measured in hours, not minutes

On several benchmarks, Fable 5 scores **more than 10 percentage points above Claude Opus 4.8**, which was itself released just two weeks prior on May 28, 2026.

---

## Safety Architecture

Fable 5 ships with a tiered safety routing system:

- Queries related to **cybersecurity, chemistry, and biology** are evaluated by a classifier and routed to Claude Opus 4.8 rather than Fable 5 when the classifier detects elevated risk
- This means most users see Fable 5 responses for general tasks but Opus 4.8 for sensitive domain queries
- Anthropic described this as "conservative safeguards" and committed to loosening them over time as red-teaming results are reviewed

Claude Mythos 5 — the unrestricted variant — is available only to vetted government and institutional cybersecurity partners.

---

## Pricing & Availability

| Period | Access |
|---|---|
| June 9–22, 2026 | Free for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans |
| June 23, 2026+ | Requires usage credits |

**API pricing (from June 23):**
- Input: $10 per million tokens
- Output: $50 per million tokens

This makes Fable 5 significantly more expensive than Opus 4.8 ($15/$75 per million was Claude 3 Opus pricing; Fable 5's pricing reflects a new top tier). For cost-sensitive applications, Claude Opus 4.8 remains the recommended default.

---

## Model ID

The model ID for API access is `claude-fable-5`. Anthropic's documentation lists it as the current recommended model for tasks requiring maximum capability.

---

## Positioning Within the Claude Family

Fable 5 sits above the Haiku/Sonnet/Opus tier structure introduced with Claude 3:

```
claude-fable-5          ← New top tier (Mythos class)
claude-opus-4-8         ← Previous top tier (released May 28, 2026)
claude-sonnet-4-6       ← Balanced tier
claude-haiku-4-5-*      ← Fast/cheap tier
```

The release suggests Anthropic is moving toward a two-track model family: a standard Haiku/Sonnet/Opus progression for everyday use, and a Mythos/Fable class for frontier tasks where cost is secondary to capability.
